detail: Zipline raised USD 1.5B at a USD 21.5B post-money valuation led by Paradigm, WCM and Layer Global, and signed a multi-year Walmart deal to scale drone delivery to 300 supercenters.
counterparty: Paradigm; WCM Investment Management; Layer Global; Walmart

detail: Re:Build raised USD 2.1B in equity led by General Catalyst and JPMorganChase's Strategic Investment Group (listed in the round-up for the week of 2 Nov 2026).
counterparty: General Catalyst; JPMorganChase Strategic Investment Group

detail: Shield AI raised a USD 1B Series H within USD 2.5B of financing (incl. USD 1B Blackstone structured equity and USD 500M debt) at a USD 28.8B post-money valuation (round-up for week of 2 Nov 2026); it also agreed to acquire Echodyne.
counterparty: Disruptive; Innovation X Capital; Blackstone; JPMorgan Chase

detail: Shield AI announced it will acquire Echodyne in a transaction valued at USD 5.3B, alongside its USD 2.5B raise at a USD 28.8B valuation (page undated).
CesiumAstro raised a USD 730M Series D led by Janus Henderson at a valuation above USD 4.5B, plus USD 100M of debt.
Northwood Space raised a USD 375M Series C co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and DFJ Growth.
Platform Accounting Group received USD 355M of strategic growth financing led by Treville Capital Group (round-up for the week of 2 Nov 2026).
Harbinger Motors raised a USD 240M Series D co-led by Tiger Global, Capricorn's Technology Impact Fund and Ridgeline, taking total capital raised since 2021 above USD 650M.
Fundz records a USD 650M Series D at a USD 9B pre-money valuation and a confidential draft S-1 submission; another page dates this round to July 2026, so the date is uncertain.
Model ML raised a USD 250M Series B led by General Atlantic and QED Investors at a USD 1.5B valuation.
Galvanize Therapeutics raised a USD 130M Series D led by HealthQuest Capital for pulsed electric field ablation technology.
Emulate raised USD 700M from investors including Unity and NVentures at a reported implied valuation of about USD 3.7B (round-up for the week of 9 Nov 2026).
VulcanForms raised USD 500M in equity led by J.P. Morgan and funds managed by Apollo (round-up for the week of 9 Nov 2026).
Torus raised USD 500M (a Series C per Bloomberg) led by Magnetar.
Path Robotics raised a USD 300M Series E led by Georgian at a USD 2.45B post-money valuation.
Modern Wealth Management raised USD 200M in hybrid debt and equity led by Centerbridge Partners (round-up for the week of 9 Nov 2026).
Imprint raised USD 130M led by Khosla Ventures at a valuation of about USD 1.9B (round-up for the week of 9 Nov 2026).
Jeeves announced USD 300M of financing capacity from Neuberger Berman Specialty Finance (equity/debt split not stated), following a USD 110M equity round led by CoinFund.
Collective raised USD 100M: a USD 40M Series B led by General Catalyst, QED and Gradient Ventures plus a USD 60M growth facility.
Genesis AI raised a USD 500M Series A co-led by Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures and Eclipse at a USD 3.5B valuation to bring its robots to factories and warehouses.
